quarantine.mr_name: CIGAR split/merge invariance for adjacent identical ops
quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P normalizes CIGAR by merging adjacent identical ops; total query-consumed length is preserved

evidence.quote: Adjacent CIGAR operations should be different (SAM Recommended Practice p134).

ambiguity_flags: SHOULD-level recommendation, not MUST — some parsers may not normalize

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P normalizes RNEXT '=' to explicit RNAME or vice versa; SAMv1 §1.4.7 allows '=' as synonym for 'same as RNAME'

evidence.quote: If the RNEXT field is '=', it has the same value as RNAME (SAMv1 §1.4.7).

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P uppercases SEQ; SAMv1 §1.4.10 states no assumptions can be made on letter cases

evidence.quote: No assumptions can be made on the letter cases of SEQ (SAMv1 §1.4.10).

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P strips zero-length CIGAR ops and merges adjacent same-type ops; SAM Recommended Practice says adjacent CIGAR operations should be different

evidence.quote: Adjacent CIGAR operations should be different (SAM Recommended Practice p134).

ambiguity_flags: SHOULD-level recommendation — zero-length ops are not explicitly forbidden by SAMv1 §1.4.6

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P is version-agnostic; SAM v1.5→1.6 added clarifications but maintained backwards-compatibility

evidence.quote: VN: Version of the SAM format accepted values: 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6 (SAMv1 §1.3).

ambiguity_flags: Some parsers may reject unknown VN values; 1.5→1.6 is backwards-compatible per spec

quarantine.mr_name: Header subtag shuffle invariance for @SQ records
quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P sorts subtags within each @SQ line; SAMv1 §1.3 does not order TAG:VALUE pairs within header lines

evidence.quote: The order of TAG:VALUE pairs within a header line is not significant (SAMv1 §1.3).

quarantine.mr_name: Header subtag shuffle invariance for @RG records
quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P sorts subtags within each @RG line; SAMv1 §1.3 does not order TAG:VALUE pairs within header lines

evidence.quote: The order of TAG:VALUE pairs within a header line is not significant (SAMv1 §1.3).

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P sorts @CO lines; SAMv1 §1.3 declares @CO to be free-text comments with no ordering semantics

evidence.quote: @CO: One-line free text comment. Multiple @CO lines are allowed (SAMv1 §1.3).

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P normalizes MAPQ to 255 for unmapped reads; SAMv1 §1.4 specifies MAPQ 255 as 'not available'

evidence.quote: MAPQ: Mapping quality. 255 indicates that the mapping quality is not available (SAMv1 §1.4).

quarantine.oracle: P(parse(x)) == P(parse(T(x))) where P sorts optional tags by tag name; SAMtags §2.1 specifies tag ordering is not significant

evidence.quote: Optional fields have no defined order (SAMtags §2.1).
